Project Overview
A prominent USA-based healthcare provider struggled with managing patient inquiries, especially during non-working hours. Limited staff availability resulted in delayed responses and reduced patient satisfaction.
To address this, we developed an AI-powered Call Center System for Healthcare, utilizing a custom-trained GPT-4 model and Twilio integration. This innovative solution streamlines patient communication via voice and text, efficiently managing routine inquiries, scheduling appointments, and seamlessly transferring emergency calls to healthcare professionals when needed, ultimately improving patient support, reducing administrative burdens, and optimizing healthcare workflows.

Outcome
By automating routine inquiries, on-clinic nurses could focus on critical patient care, leading to a 60% reduction in their administrative tasks and a significant boost in overall productivity.
Faster response times and 24/7 availability enhanced the patient experience, contributing to a 75% increase in patient satisfaction and a notable reduction in frustration levels
Automated call handling and query categorization streamlined patient interactions, improving overall system performance and resulting in a 50% increase in operational efficiency.
